findings.what_happened: The healthcare agent repeated the caller's name incorrectly during identity confirmation.
findings.why_problem: An incorrect name can cause record-matching failures and risks associating the request with the wrong patient.
findings.evidence: I have your name as Drew Bartinez and your date of birth as March 21st, 1988.

manual_checks: The agent does not continue using the incorrect month.
The conversation proceeds without losing context.
